scope: BART-large-CNN / same 200 calibration and 500 test documents; no independent confirmation dataset
random_source_policy: Keep both endpoints and uniformly sample remaining original source positions without replacement using a fixed document-specific CPU RNG; sorted positions; the selection is shared across delta and generation seed. One fixed random policy draw, not a multi-policy average.

groups.name: retention
groups.question: Are observed changes sensitive to the retention ratio?

groups.name: nucleus256
groups.question: Do cache effects persist when the decoder length ceiling is raised?

groups.name: topk50
groups.question: Do cache effects persist under a second sampling rule?

groups.name: random50
groups.question: Are source-cache effects specific to uniform-spaced position selection?

paired_analysis.primary_posthoc_family: cross-self and interaction x deltas 0/2 x support_proxy, rougeL, displayed_text_z, content_tokens = 16 intervals
paired_analysis.aggregation: average the three matched seed differences within each document, then resample whole documents; also report each seed
paired_analysis.intervals: pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap, plus Bonferroni nominal familywise 95% intervals for the 16 declared posthoc comparisons
paired_analysis.null_caution: An interval spanning zero does not establish no effect, equivalence or exact additivity. No equivalence margin is defined.

human_audit.blinding: Hide condition, delta, seed, NLI, watermark and expected outcome from annotation materials. Annotator may already know study-level findings; disclose this.
human_audit.legacy_mapping: not_in_source maps to unclear only for a legacy ternary export; retain the four-way original human label
human_audit.sampling: Freeze 20 random test document IDs, sample one sentence from every matched summary without inspecting scores, randomize display order. Original 100 sentence selections unchanged.
human_audit.audit_scope: Small proxy-validity audit, not a precise population hallucination-rate benchmark. Same document/seed repetitions are not independent. No LLM labels counted as human.

reporting: Report all fixed conditions including null or reversed results; no selection of best seed. Raw checkpoints and original protocols remain immutable. Changes after freeze require a separate explicit amendment.
